subject: BlueOak acquisition — payment routing, VAT registration, and billing address consolidation
messages:
From: Sofia Gomes <sofia.gomes@blueoak.com>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Marco Santini <marco.santini@blueoak.com>
Date: 2026-11-21T09:14:22-05:00
Subject: Upcoming billing changes after acquisition (need Redwood's remit/VAT details)

Hi Vanessa,

Quick intro — I'm Sofia, Head of Finance at BlueOak. As you may know, BlueOak was acquired by Northbridge Holdings and we're consolidating our billing across the new parent. We need to update Redwood's billing records so that invoices for BlueOak Systems are routed to the new remit and VAT profile.

High-level ask: can you confirm the steps we need from our side to:
- Change the remit address and contact for invoices
- Provide VAT-withholding and reverse-charge documentation for our EU entity
- Route AR payments to our acquiring treasury team (new bank details) after Dec 1st

I've attached our preliminary acquisition stub and the new legal name we'd like on invoices. We'll need your AP contact and any form Redwood requires for remit changes.

Attachments: [attachment: Acquisition_stub.pdf (PDF, 120 KB)]

Thanks —
Sofia Gomes
Head of Finance, BlueOak Systems
sofia.gomes@blueoak.com
+44 20 5555 0101

From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwoodinference.com>
To: Sofia Gomes <sofia.gomes@blueoak.com>
Cc: Marco Santini <marco.santini@blueoak.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2026-11-21T11:03:05-05:00
Subject: Re: Upcoming billing changes after acquisition (need Redwood's remit/VAT details)

Hi Sofia — great to meet you and congrats on the close.

Thanks for the heads up. Short answers up front: we can support updating the remit address and legal name on invoices, we accept VAT certificates for EU entities, and we can route payments to the acquiring treasury once we have completed our AP change request (signed form + bank remittance confirmation).

To move quickly, please:
1) Fill out the attached "remit change" spreadsheet (I've populated Redwood's vendor ID) and sign the PDF version.
2) Share the VAT certificate and new legal entity registration (we'll need company registration number).
3) If payments move to a different bank, please include a bank confirmation letter or a stamped supplier bank mandate.

I've looped in Marissa (AP lead) who will own the change on our side and Ben from collections in case we need to coordinate outstanding invoice routing. Expect Marissa to send a DocuSign for signature + our internal remit-change checklist.

Attachments: [attachment: Redwood_remit_update_form.xlsx (XLSX, 24 KB)]

Best,
Vanessa Ortiz
Customer Finance Lead | Redwood Inference
vanessa.ortiz@redwoodinference.com

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
To: Sofia Gomes <sofia.gomes@blueoak.com>, Marco Santini <marco.santini@blueoak.com>
Cc: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwoodinference.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2026-11-22T08:09:37-05:00
Subject: Re: Upcoming billing changes after acquisition (need Redwood's remit/VAT details)

Hi Sofia / Marco — I'm Marissa on Redwood's AP team. Quick checklist and timeline from our side: 
- I'll open an AP change ticket when I receive the signed remit_change form and the VAT certificate.
- Standard processing time: 3 business days after receiving complete docs; we'll set the effective date to Dec 1st as requested.
- For payments: outstanding invoices dated before Dec 1st will be paid per current remits unless you request otherwise in writing.

DocuSign link (active for 7 days): https://www.docusign.net/BlueOak/Envelope12345
Please sign the remit form there. After signature, upload the VAT certificate to the Drive folder linked below or reply with the PDF.

Drive: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3cBlueOakBilling

If you prefer, we can accept a notarized bank mandate for new bank instructions.

Regards,
Marissa Cole
Accounts Payable Manager | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com
[attachment: Redwood_AP_checklist.pdf (PDF, 45 KB)]

From: Marco Santini <marco.santini@blueoak.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, Sofia Gomes <sofia.gomes@blueoak.com>
Cc: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2026-11-24T09:32:10-05:00
Subject: Re: Upcoming billing changes after acquisition (need Redwood's remit/VAT details)

Hi Marissa / Vanessa — thanks. We've completed the DocuSign and attached the VAT cert and signed remit PDF in this thread.

See attachments: [attachment: Signed_remit_change.pdf (PDF, 22 KB)], [attachment: BlueOak_VAT_certificate.pdf (PDF, 310 KB)]

Note: New legal name for invoices: BlueOak Holdings UK Limited (Company Reg: 78654321). Please begin using that name and the EU VAT number shown on the certificate for invoices issued on/after Dec 1st. Bank change will be communicated as soon as treasury finalizes the SWIFT confirmation (expected by Nov 27).

On Mon, Nov 23, 2026 at 10:10 AM Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwoodinference.com> wrote:
> Thanks — we'll take it from here and confirm once the vendor record is updated.

Best,
Marco

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>
To: Marco Santini <marco.santini@blueoak.com>, Sofia Gomes <sofia.gomes@blueoak.com>

Date: 2026-11-25T16:05:00-05:00
Subject: Re: Upcoming billing changes after acquisition (need Redwood's remit/VAT details)

Marco / Sofia — quick confirmation from collections: the vendor record has been updated to BlueOak Holdings UK Limited and the VAT number uploaded to the vendor file. Effective date for new invoices: 2026-12-01.

Outstanding invoices with invoice numbers INV-2026-0912 and INV-2026-0931 will be routed to the existing bank this week unless you instruct otherwise in writing. Once you share the treasury SWIFT confirmation, we will update the payment instructions and confirm next steps for any in-flight payments.

I've also attached a short note describing where the new remit will appear on your invoice PDF for ease of reconciliation.

Attachments: [attachment: remit_placement_note.txt (TXT, 1.2 KB)]

Thanks —
